oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: quick progress check in 5 days (2026-03-29). Add status to linked issues to avoid duplicate pages.

marta: Proposed triage excerpt to merge into playbook:
- Step 0: Gather context (route, model variant, recent deploys).
- Step 1: Check for recent evictions/ooms:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l role=router -o json | jq '.items[] | {name: .metadata.name, status: .status.phase, reason: .status.reason}'
kubectl -n inference logs -l role=router --since=20m | grep -iE "evict|OOM|Killed" || true
redwood infra autoscaler status --pool router --since 20m > /tmp/autoscaler.out
cat /tmp/autoscaler.out | head -n 200
```
- Step 2: If evictions > 3 in 20m -> escalate to infra-oncall, attach autoscaler.out and pod list.
- Step 3: If no ack in 10m -> page eng-pager with template below.

devin: pager template I'll add:
"""
[URGENT] inference router pool evictions: saw X evictions in 20m on pool=router. Autoscaler decisions attached: <link>. Please investigate memory pressure and recent deploys. -> @infra-oncall
"""

algina: runbook note: prewarm failure fallback -> pin to smaller model variant and scale conservatively; notify product about degraded latency.

marta: ownership tracking pattern: open a short-lived project card per action with owner, ETA, and weekly check-in until closed. I'll make the cards and link them here.

li-wang: added autoscaler test plan to the issue. Will run in staging and post metrics. If cold-start regressions appear, we'll hold and enable prewarm.

algina: added TTL verification to the prewarm task checklist after seeing a noisy service with 5s TTL.

devin: PRs incoming for the runbook edits and pager template. Will mark them ready for review after small lint pass.

samir: once nightly metric is in, I'll add a dashboard tile and weekly trend check in the incident board.

oncall-bot: Follow-up: next automatic reminder 2026-03-29 09:00 UTC.

marta: agree with scale-up + deploy. Add rate-limiting and a max concurrency flag to avoid thundering herd.

li-wang: will validate no regressions in staging. If OK, rollout to canary then global.

marta: thanks all, keeping this open for updates. :white_check_mark:
